blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — The local government of Lantapan and communities across Bukidnon province expressed deep sorrow over the passing of Datu Victorino “Migketay” Saway, a pillar of indigenous culture, peacebuilding and environmental stewardship. The 72-year-old Datu Migketay, affectionately known as Datu Vic, leaves behind a profound legacy as a tribal leader, academic, peacekeeper and environmentalist. An Anthropology graduate from Silliman University and recipient of the Fr. Francisco R. Demetrio SJ Award from Xavier University-Ateneo de Cagayan, he dedicated his life to protecting and promoting the rich heritage of the Talaandig and other indigenous groups in the country.
